reserved_specialization_keys.rule: Goal 4 must add a distinct static Astro component and registry entry in the same accepted integration change as the Demo 2 record.
Goal 6 or Goal 7 must add a distinct static Astro component and registry entry in the same accepted integration change as the Demo 3 record.

route_adapter.behavior: Statically enumerate configured records, resolve the bounded component key, and render the selected Astro component with the typed demo record.

visibility.listed_false: The record remains absent from the gallery but retains its statically generated direct detail/output routes.
visibility.noindex_true: The detail route is noindex and absent from the sitemap.
visibility.output_routes: Always noindex and absent from the sitemap.

shared_primitives.composition_policy: Each run may select a distinct composition; shared constraints do not impose one page layout.

authority: Local source and test changes only; no staging, commit, push, deployment, or provider mutation.
